meta.dam_method: share of the area's 2020 Census block population whose block internal point is inside (blocks with no people ignored): inside any dam evacuation zone, times the area's population (the same method as the tsunami share)
meta.dam_note: State dam evacuation zones show the area that could flood if a dam fails; they are planning zones, not a forecast.
meta.low_range_text: Populated Census areas with less than 50% of people within rated siren range
meta.no_sirens_text: prioritise WEA, radio and trusted messengers
meta.outside_range_text: Populated Census areas whose land point is farther than 3,400 ft from every outdoor siren (HI-EMA manufacturer rating; actual range varies)
meta.siren_method: share of the area's 2020 Census block population whose block internal point is inside (blocks with no people ignored): within 3,400 ft of a permanent siren on the same island (the same method as the tsunami share)

siren_radius.source: Hawaiʻi Emergency Management Agency, All-Hazards Statewide Outdoor Warning Siren System: "The sirens output is 121 decibels and propagate with a manufacture radius of 3,400 feet. This range may vary due to environmental and surrounding physical conditions."
